title: Three Months and One Short Bill
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：household　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 household 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the accountant ① balanced the household that no clerk in the store would have recorded, and he said the balancing was the whole of the quarter. The ② household, meaning the family itself and not the bill, ran three quarters and stayed unrecorded in the book; a household, he said, is the only thing in a store that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ household in that store had the same short bill beside it, and the ④ household at the far counter, meaning the budget they kept for the children to manage and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A household, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the accountant said the recording is the part that fills three quarters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the household was the whole of the matter, meaning the account and not the family. The ⑥ household, meaning the account and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; household, he said, is either something you balance or the only word that means both a family and a account. He said the account is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ household had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short bill. The ⑧ household of the whole thing, the accountant wrote in March, was one store and three quarters of recording; household, he said, is either the budget at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ household I remember is the family recorded in the ledger, which closed in 1974 and is still recorded as the quietest in the store. A ⑩ household, my mother said in 1976, is the only family that improves by being recorded; every household, she said, is a account that has agreed to look like a family. She said the account was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 家庭；户（指店铺里每一户旁边的那一户）
B. n. 家庭；户（指那户一家人本身，与账单相对）
C. 固定搭配：balance the household 平衡一户人家的开支
D. n. 家庭；户（指留给孩子们管的那一笔那一户）
E. n. 家用之事（抽象总称，指一处店铺的家庭之事）
F. n. 家庭；户（指账簿里写到、被记下的的那一户）
G. n. 账目、开支（指一件事里人人都算却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 开支（抽象总称，指人人都算却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: balanced the household that no clerk in the store would have recorded
The household, meaning the family itself and not the bill
the household at the far counter
the household was the whole of the matter
the household had become a line in a ledger
The household of the whole thing
A household, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: balance the household 意为“平衡一户人家的开支”，1967 年那位会计把店铺里没有一位店员肯记下的一户人家做了一遍。
household 意为“家庭；户”，指那户一家人本身而不是账单，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记下。
household 意为“家庭；户”，指店铺里每一户旁边的那一户，每一户旁边都有同一张薄薄的账单。
household 意为“家庭；户”，指最远那段柜台留给孩子们管的那一笔那一户，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
household 意为“账目、开支”，指一件事里人人都算却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔账目就是那件事的全部。
household 意为“开支”，指人人都算却无人提起的那样东西而不是那户一家人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
household 意为“家庭；户”，指账簿里写到、被记下的的那一户，到 1972 年这一户成了账簿里的一行。
household 意为“家用之事”，会计三月写道，整件事的家庭之事是一处店铺和三个季度的记下。
household 意为“家庭；户”，我记得的是账簿里记下过的那一户，1974 年结清了，至今仍被说成店铺里最安静的一户。
household 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，家庭是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的一家人。
